name: Afghani Soya Chaap
steps: Soak cashews in hot water for 15 minutes and blend with green chili to a fine paste. Cut soya chaap into thick pieces, pat dry and score lightly so the marinade enters.
Whisk yogurt, cashew paste, cream, ginger-garlic, lemon juice, white pepper, garam masala and salt. Coat chaap thoroughly and refrigerate 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 220°C. Thread chaap onto skewers or spread on a lined tray, leaving space between pieces. Brush lightly with oil.
Roast 15–18 minutes, turning once, until hot through with charred spots at the edges. For a skillet, sear on medium-high heat 4–5 minutes per side.
Rest 3 minutes, sprinkle coriander, and serve hot with lemon and mint chutney. Do not bury the charred chaap in extra sauce.
tips: Choose clearly labelled vegetarian soya chaap and check the package ingredients before marinating.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
